gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Blink's Solaris, ChatGPT's 'Best choice — Official Blink' pick, is now sold on Amazon as 'Only compatible with Outdoor 2K+ camera' ($39.99 on 2026-11-17). That leaves a cabled third-party panel such as Wasserstein's ($36.99, USB-C converter included for the Outdoor 4) as the only priced option still listing the Outdoor 4.
standout_why: Compared against the two cited pages (the Blink Solaris FAQ and the Blink Solar Panel Mount FAQ) and the uncited Blink support results (setup guide, overview, specs). The Solar Panel Mount FAQ lists the Outdoor 4 as incompatible but says nothing about Solaris. The Solaris FAQ as read today names only the Outdoor 2K+. It never mentions the Outdoor 4 and never says it is excluded, so it holds the fact only by omission. ChatGPT cited that same page on 2026-11-07 as saying Solaris works with the Outdoor 4. No result says outright that Solaris is not for the Outdoor 4. None prices both the official and the third-party options side by side. Only the Amazon listing title says 'Only compatible with Outdoor 2K+'.
decides: This reverses ChatGPT's pick. Blink's support FAQ, setup guide and Amazon listing all name only the Outdoor 2K+ for Solaris. Blink's own Solar Panel Mount excludes the Outdoor 4. That leaves a third-party panel that lists the Outdoor 4 as the pick for the shopper's camera. Wasserstein costs $36.99 and comes with a 13.1 ft cable and a USB-C converter. Our page's Solaris row ('Fits: Yes: Outdoor 4 and Outdoor 2K+') needs correcting.
